verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique is a web portal with user dashboards, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for it. The evidence only documents conventional formality-tracking dashboards, status visibility and a separate tutorial app (Start INPI). Nothing describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
